why: Annual road tax of a battery-electric car by total motor power (from 1 Jan 2026, same rates in Sabah and Sarawak): RM20 up to 50 kW, +RM10 per 10 kW block up to 100 kW (RM70), +RM20 per block to 210 kW (RM280), +RM30 to 310 kW (RM575), +RM50 to 410 kW (RM1,065). Block edges are the stated 9.999 kW steps rounded to 10 kW; checked against the article's examples (70 kW RM40, 105 kW RM80, 210 kW RM280, 300 kW RM545, 390 kW RM965). Above 410 kW the table is not published in text, so the highest band is used

Petrol car (private, Peninsular): flat amount by engine capacity: RM70 for 1,201–1,400 cc and RM90 for 1,401–1,600 cc are confirmed by several guides; the RM20 (to 1,000 cc) and RM55 (1,001–1,200 cc) steps are from the same published schedule but not confirmed on the pages read. Above 1,600 cc a progressive rate applies and is not in the table; no petrol car above 1,600 cc is listed
